reasons: With a 4 MC per-semester limit, semesters 5 to 8 give only four course slots, but the required courses plus CS3103 prerequisite CS2105 total eight 4-MC courses.
CS3103 is offered only in Sem 1 and needs CS2105 first; it cannot go in Sem 5 with no earlier term, and Sem 7 is blocked by the fixed CS3268 plus the 4 MC limit.
Therefore no arrangement satisfies all constraints.
